sentences.en: Copernicus studied mathematics and astronomy at the University of Krakow.
sentences.zh: 哥白尼在克拉科夫大学学习数学和天文学。

sentences.en: My father studies astronomy, or the science of stars.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸研究天文学，也就是星星的科学。

sentences.en: Nicolaus Copernicus is considered the founder of modern astronomy.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯·哥白尼被认为是现代天文学的创始人。

mnemonic: astro（星星）+nomy（学科）→研究星星的学科
